status: Two PWM power-control ports requested; LQFP100 allocation proposed with existing interfaces/LEDs retained. Native schematic and PCB remain Rev E RBT6 header versions.

dual_PWM_allocation.user_preference: Retain all existing interfaces and indicators; evaluate a larger pin-count package.
dual_PWM_allocation.selection_status: VBT6 is the recommended planning candidate, not an implemented component change.
dual_PWM_allocation.retained: Two ABZ, two independent SPI, two independent I2C, one TTL UART, one CAN, SWD, HSE/BOOT/RESET and four GPIO LEDs plus power LED.
dual_PWM_allocation.additional_reservations: Exactly ten analog connectors total. Only the second TIM15 brake channel remains an optional pin reserve. Eight other ADC-capable pads are unallocated and have no terminals.
dual_PWM_allocation.signal_pad_budget: 62 planned plus 1 optional brake reserve = 63 of 86 signal/special pads; 23 remain unallocated. Fourteen other package pads are power/reference/ground.

FOC_capacity_note.second_motor_status: Two PWM ports are retained. Motor and PFC applications are alternatives on the same controller; PFC operation does not include motor control. Basic dual-motor capability remains a separately validated motor-mode option; saved inverter is still single-motor.
FOC_capacity_note.MCU: Proposed STM32G431VBT6 LQFP100; native remains STM32G431RBT6 LQFP64.
FOC_capacity_note.hardware_basis: TIM1 and TIM8 expose two sets of three complementary PWM pairs; ADC1/ADC2 would be shared by both control loops.
FOC_capacity_note.conflict_scope: The list describes saved Rev E RBT6. The linked LQFP100 proposal relocates SPI3, brake, ARM and LEDs and provides independent A/B controls.
FOC_capacity_note.qualification: Two simultaneous 20kHz FOC loops plus ThreadX have not been profiled or validated in this project. A second motor needs another power stage and independent sensing/protection, GPIO replanning and shared-ADC timing design.
FOC_capacity_note.manufacturer_reference: https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/evspin32g4-dual.html — ST reference uses one STM32G431 embedded in STSPIN32G4 for two motors, with single-shunt sensing; it does not validate this project's three-shunt topology.

confirmed.mechanical_support: Copper standoffs provide mechanical support between controller and inverter.
confirmed.controller_interfaces: Controller exposes interfaces grouped by function, including ADC, I2C and SPI.

PWM.port_B: TIM8: PC6/PC10, PC7/PC11, PC8/PC12, all AF4 in the LQFP100 proposal.
PWM.physical_pin_order: Proposed logical order: GND, CH1, CH1N, CH2, CH2N, CH3, CH3N, GND. Connector model/mating-view drawing pending; see controller_dual_pwm_ports.csv.

ADC.quantity_scope: Exactly ten independent analog connectors total, clarified by user; not eight plus ten.

operating_modes.motor_mode: One motor or the separately evaluated basic dual-motor option; no PFC loop on the same MCU.
operating_modes.PFC_mode: One Boost or Vienna power-board application; no motor control on this MCU. No dual-PFC or LLC operating target is implied.
operating_modes.PWM_usage: Keep both physical PWM ports. Configure only the selected application's required outputs; unused outputs remain disabled.
operating_modes.ADC_usage: Reuse the same ten generic analog connectors between alternative applications; do not add motor and PFC sensing counts together.

confirmed.signal_connector_family: XUNPU GH1.25 side-entry SMT; ADC2P/PWM8P recommendations accepted for planning.

proposed_ADC_connectors.status: Two-contact ADC structure accepted; physical pin order and native footprint migration pending.
proposed_ADC_connectors.signal_definition: Conditioned low-voltage sampling outputs, not raw bus/phase voltages or raw shunt terminals. Existing NTC channel is a conditioned voltage from the inverter front end.

ADC_group_rules.regular_or_injected: Conversion group is software-configurable on the ADC's supported input channels; connectors are not physically regular-only or injected-only.
ADC_group_rules.pad_to_ADC_channel: Fixed by STM32G431 internal connections; GPIO/ADC instance/channel cannot be assigned arbitrarily.
ADC_group_rules.three_phase_current_simultaneity: Two ADCs cannot sample three independent currents at one identical instant. Injected sequence ranks remain sequential within each ADC; detailed trigger/window strategy is not frozen.

proposed_ADC_connectors.receiver_protection: Propose placing final ADC RC, clamps and digital input pullups/protection on controller; not implemented.

wire_count_example.scope: Historical 8-ADC single-inverter harness example only, not the new ten-port controller wire count.
wire_count_example.assumptions: ADC2P per channel, prior proposed CTRL6P and 5V supply2P, receiver protection moved to controller so no cross-board 3V3_CORE_REF wire.

connector_family_candidate.description: XUNPU GH1.25 horizontal SMT locking-housing family recommended; ADC2P and PWM8P candidates with domestic mating-set records.
connector_family_candidate.note: ADC2P and PWM8P model recommendations accepted by user; do not imply other pin-count procurement models or physical pin order are finalized.
connector_family_candidate.selection_scope: Accepted for planning; exact ADC2P and PWM8P board-header recommendations accepted. Other pin-count models, mating drawings and BOM migration remain pending.

analog_budget_note.assumptions: Motor and PFC are alternative applications on this controller. Each mode uses the same ten ports. Counts are project interface budgets, not claimed manufacturer mandatory channel counts.

dual_motor_with_phase_voltages.description: Basic dual-motor set plus three phase voltages per motor.

single_boost_PFC.description: Inductor current, input voltage, output voltage and NTC; six ports remain.

single_Vienna_PFC.description: Three currents, three input voltages, two half-bus voltages and NTC; one port remains.

analog_budget_note.excluded_from_target: Motor plus PFC simultaneously on this MCU; previous 14/17-input combined examples are not requirements.
analog_budget_note.decision: Keep exactly ten analog connectors. They cover the defined standalone Boost/Vienna and basic motor-mode examples; no expansion is required for the PFC alternative. Dual-motor phase-voltage sensing remains outside this ten-port example.

ADC_usage_examples.status: Hypothetical sensor assignments, not frozen power-board circuits or ADC conversion schedules.

single_motor_spare_options.ADC_08: Possible future DC input current, requiring a new sensing front end.
single_motor_spare_options.ADC_10: Possible future motor NTC, requiring a matching excitation/divider front end.

measurement_notes: Single-motor phase voltages refer to conditioned PWM phase-node measurements as in the saved inverter; no sinusoidal post-filter output is implied.
Boost input voltage example is rectified input; confirm the actual sensing point when the topology is selected.
Vienna upper/lower half-bus inputs are conditioned voltage measurements of the two bus-capacitor sections; do not tie the physical bus midpoint to controller GND just to obtain these measurements.
All ports receive low-voltage, reference-compatible conditioned signals. An NTC role needs a divider/excitation front end; it does not mean wiring a raw NTC directly across a signal/GND ADC port.

mechanical_fit_study.status: Nominal-body two-face alternative only; not a selected placement or routing/DRC result.
mechanical_fit_study.needs_review: Exact footprints, mating housings, latch access, bottom clearance and full assembly/routing.
